camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainQpsDataByLayer --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2019-11-30T05:40:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2019-11-30T05:33:00Z' --Layer all --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the number of queries per second (QPS) at a specific layer for one or more accelerated domain names. You can query data collected within the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainQpsDataByLayer查询加速域名的每秒访问次数QPS，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-qps-data-by-layer --domain-name example.com --start-time 2019-11-30T05:33:00Z --end-time 2019-11-30T05:40:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --layer all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainQpsDataByLayer

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify a maximum of 500 domain names in a request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries the QPS of all accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in the ISO 8601 standard. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in the ISO 8601 standard. The time is displayed in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time interval between the data entries to return. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see Description
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) for your Alibaba Cloud CDN service. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISPs. If you do not set this parameter, all ISPs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query the most recent region list. If you do not set this parameter, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh: 地域英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The layers at which you want to query the number of queries per second. Valid values:

Network layer: IPv4and IPv6.

Application layer: http, https, and quic.

all: The default value. Both the network and application layers are included
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度。取值：

网络层：IPv4、IPv6。

应用层：http、https、quic。

all（默认值）：包含网络层和应用层
parameters.name: layer

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

Layer.description_en: The layer at which the data was collected

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried
